title: Online room connection state diagram
description: The life of one connection to a match relay. The connecting state is the promise Room.open returns; callers get a Room only once the relay has welcomed it. The relay that sends welcome, join and leave belongs to the games hub, outside this repository.

states.description: A WebSocket to /games/multiplayer/match/{id} is opening; it waits up to 8 seconds for the relay's first message.
Welcomed: it knows its slot, the match size, the players' names and who is in the room, and pings every 3 seconds.
The relay's first message wasn't a welcome, or the socket closed or timed out first; open() rejects with the reason.
The socket closed while the room was open.

transitions.action: Record the slot, size, names and peers; start pinging; resolve with the Room.
Reject with the message's reason (missing, not-yours); close the socket.

transitions.trigger: 8-second timeout, a socket close or a failed WebSocket constructor

transitions.action: Update the peers and their round trips; notify listeners.
Round trip = best of the last five; tell the others when it moved by 5 ms or more.
Stop pinging; close the socket with 1000 bye.
Stop pinging; notify listeners with closed, reason lost.
